symptom.description: One sentence in English restating what the reporter observed. Translate if the bug text is not in English.

probable_cause.description: 1-3 short sentences on the mechanism: what the code does now, and why that produces the reported symptom. Grounded in code you actually read, never invented.

repository.description: The repository most likely to contain the cause, exactly as named in <repositories>. Use 'unclear' only when the evidence genuinely does not point at one.

confidence.description: high = you read the responsible code and the mechanism explains the symptom. medium = right area, exact line not proven. low = plausible direction only. Never inflate.

note.description: Only when it changes what the developer should do: the cause sits outside readable source (vendored package, binary dependency, submodule pin), several repositories are jointly involved, or the reported behavior looks intentional. Omit otherwise.

locations.description: Ranked candidate places to look, best first. Prefer 1-4 entries. When the exact line is unproven, still name the responsible file or module rather than widening to a whole directory.

path.description: Repository-relative path, e.g. packages/client/src/store/FilesStore.ts. For a cause outside readable source, the closest real artifact (e.g. common/ASC.NewAi/package.json).

line.description: Line number in the checked-out file when you can point at one. Omit rather than guess.

why.description: One or two sentences tying this exact place to the symptom.

ruled_out.description: Repositories or subsystems you inspected and excluded, so nobody repeats the work. Include a repository here when its code is genuinely correct for this symptom - not merely unread.

reason.description: One sentence: what you checked there and why it is not the cause.

missing_repository.description: Set this ONLY when the cause almost certainly lives in code you were not given: name that one repository (or the package it ships, when you cannot name the repository) and nothing else. The pipeline re-runs the triage with it included, so an unfounded guess here costs a whole extra run - leave it out unless the readable code genuinely rules itself out.

next_steps.description: At most 3 short sentences: the fastest checks that would confirm or refute the hypothesis (a log line to look at, a value to print, a config to compare). Omit when the locations already say everything.

fix_sketch.description: Minimal corrected code, only when confidence is high and the fix is small and obvious. Never a speculative rewrite; omit entirely when unsure.

fix_lang.description: Code-fence language tag for fix_sketch, e.g. 'typescript', 'csharp', 'scss'.
